$comment: Single source of truth for the public npm names of the publishable workspace packages (issue 15). The workspace keeps its provisional names; scripts/release/stage.mjs rewrites them into the selected namespace when it packs release tarballs. Every package listed here releases at the facade's version (lockstep, issue 62): .changeset/config.json puts exactly these in one "fixed" group. See design/release.md.

target.status: Owner ruling 2026-10-09: upstream's @pixi scope, pending agreement with the pixijs maintainers (issue 41).

fallback.status: Placeholder for a fork-owned scope if issue 41 does not grant @pixi. The owner has not chosen this name.

publish.reason: Nothing is published until the owner configures a destination (issue 15, issue 41). Staged tarballs keep "private": true while this is false.

abi.$comment: The ABI declarations of the last release (null before Release 1): { core: CORE_ABI, adapters: { [source file]: [{ major, minor }] } }. scripts/release/version.mjs records them after `changeset version`; policy.mjs requires at least a minor lockstep release, with an "ABI" note in a changeset, when the source declarations differ from them (issue 62).

packages/pixi-7.$comment: The Pixi 7 adapter (issue 16). It releases at the facade's version like every package here (lockstep), although it targets pixi.js 7; the facade stays on Pixi 8.

neverPublished.$comment: Workspace packages that are never released. Each must be private, and .changeset/config.json must ignore exactly these.

textRewrites.$comment: Provisional tokens in packed files that are not package names. react-shared is private, so its mentions become the bare workspace name.
